world.title: Death to the compromiser: Iran hardliners turn on leadership over US deal
world.summary: Hardline factions in Iran are criticizing senior leaders for allegedly orchestrating a "soft coup" following a recent agreement with the United States. This accusation has intensified existing internal divisions within the political establishment. Notably, Mojtaba Khamenei, the Supreme Leader's son, has remained out of public view during this period of heightened tension among Iran's leadership.

world.title: Tate brothers arrested in Miami as UK adds rape, trafficking charges
world.summary: Andrew and Tristan Tate were arrested in Miami, Florida, on a sealed warrant, according to the United States Marshals Service. The UK government is pursuing their extradition to face charges of rape and sex trafficking. The arrest occurred on Saturday, and the authorities are coordinating efforts to address the legal proceedings related to the allegations against the brothers.

world.title: U.S. military launches new airstrikes to ‘swiftly punish’ Iran for deaths of U.S. troops
world.summary: The U.S. military conducted airstrikes against Iran on July 19, 2026, in response to attacks that resulted in the deaths of two American troops and left one missing. The strikes targeted oil traffic control linked to Iran's Revolutionary Guard. This action aims to “swiftly punish” Iran for its involvement in the attacks on U.S. service members in Jordan.

business.title: Man quits Rs 38,000-a-month job, starts tea shop, now earns Rs 1.8 lakh every month
business.summary: A former Teleperformance employee left his Rs 38,000-a-month job to open a tea shop, investing Rs 2 lakh. He now reportedly earns Rs 1.8 lakh monthly, with nearly Rs 1 lakh in profit. The story has gone viral on social media, prompting discussions about entrepreneurship and the risks involved in leaving traditional employment for business opportunities.

business.title: US judge to Meta's laid off employees: Cannot stop the company from job cuts, but can reconsider if you can provide how ...
business.summary: A US judge has ruled that Meta Platforms can proceed with its planned layoffs of 26 employees who filed a lawsuit against the company. The judge stated that while the layoffs cannot be halted, the employees may have the opportunity to reconsider their position if they can provide additional information. This decision allows Meta to continue its restructuring efforts.

business.title: India's IT model is out of date. Can the industry reinvent itself?
business.summary: Indian IT companies have historically adapted to technological changes, but the rise of AI poses a significant challenge to their traditional pyramid model, which relies on a large workforce handling repetitive tasks. This shift raises critical questions about the future direction of the industry and how it can reinvent itself to remain competitive in an evolving technological landscape.

technology.title: iPhone 15 now available at its lowest price: Check the offer
technology.summary: The iPhone 15 is now available at a reduced price on Flipkart, with the 128GB model priced at Rs 58,900. This offer represents one of the lowest prices for the device to date and is available for a limited time. Customers are encouraged to check additional offers, including bank benefits, before making their purchase.

technology.title: Why Are Nothing's New 'B' Series Phones So Much Cheaper?
technology.summary: Nothing recently launched the Phone 4(b), part of its new b-series of smartphones, which is priced lower than the Phone 4(a). The reduction in cost is attributed to several downgrades, including a plastic back. Despite these changes, the Phone 4(b) retains the distinctive design characteristic of Nothing's previous models, maintaining brand identity while offering a more affordable option.

technology.title: Serious WordPress Vulnerability Allows Remote Code Execution
technology.summary: A critical vulnerability in WordPress, termed “wp2shell,” allows anonymous hackers to execute remote code without authentication, affecting millions of standard installations without plugins. This pre-authentication remote code execution (RCE) flaw poses significant risks to website security. Site owners are urged to take immediate protective measures to safeguard their platforms against potential exploitation by malicious actors.

sports.title: ‘Messi is going to score’: Kylian Mbappe eclipses him, but admits he would swap record for a World Cup final place
sports.summary: Kylian Mbappé became the FIFA World Cup's all-time top scorer, surpassing Lionel Messi, but expressed that he would exchange this record for a chance to compete in the final. France's campaign ended with a defeat to England, despite Mbappé scoring twice. He acknowledged that personal achievements are less meaningful without team success in the tournament.

sports.title: Kylian Mbappe passes Lionel Messi for career World Cup scoring record with 22 goals
sports.summary: Kylian Mbappe surpassed Lionel Messi for the career World Cup scoring record on July 18, 2026, by scoring twice in the third-place match against England, bringing his total to 22 goals. This achievement places him at the top of the tournament's scoring race, with 10 goals in the current World Cup, two more than Messi.

sports.title: Beyond Tiki-Taka: The tactical evolution that has Spain one win from FIFA World Cup glory
sports.summary: Spain, initially overlooked as a World Cup favorite, has evolved tactically beyond its traditional tiki-taka style. As the tournament progressed, they demonstrated adaptability and strategic depth, positioning themselves for a potential championship victory. With one win needed to secure the title, Spain's performance has garnered attention, shifting focus from other pre-tournament favorites like France and Argentina.

health.title: The vibration plate boom: Separating fitness fact from Instagram fiction
health.summary: Vibration plates are gaining popularity as fitness gadgets promising quick results. Experts warn these devices provide limited benefits and should not replace traditional exercise. Research indicates their effectiveness in rehabilitation and for older adults. However, claims of significant fat loss and body sculpting lack scientific evidence. Vibration plates are best used to complement, rather than substitute, conventional fitness and nutrition.

health.title: Chennai: Garbage chokes Virugambakkam canal; it stinks, lament residents
health.summary: Residents of Virugambakkam, Chennai, report that garbage accumulation in the canal is worsening due to low clearance under the Tamilar Street bridge. The canal, which connects to the Cooum River, is filled with plastic waste, thermocol, and wooden debris. Locals express concern over the unpleasant odor and the environmental impact of the trapped waste.

health.title: Kerala reports sharp rise in viral fevers, dengue, waterborne diseases during monsoon
health.summary: Kerala has reported a notable increase in viral fevers, mosquito-borne diseases, and waterborne infections since the monsoon began. Public health experts indicate that viral fever cases have risen by 19 percent compared to the same period last year. The surge in these illnesses highlights ongoing public health concerns as the state navigates the challenges posed by the rainy season.

science.title: Why Venus is hotter than Mercury?
science.summary: Venus, once a tropical paradise with oceans and clouds, became hotter than Mercury due to the Sun's increasing brightness. As the solar system formed 4.5 billion years ago, conditions on Venus changed dramatically, leading to a thick atmosphere that traps heat. In contrast, Mercury, despite being closest to the Sun, lacks this greenhouse effect, resulting in lower temperatures.

science.title: Scientists fitted homing pigeons with tiny backpacks and cameras to discover how their eyes really work in flight
science.summary: Scientists equipped homing pigeons with tiny backpacks and cameras to study their vision during flight. The innovative setup included hand-stitched hoods inspired by falconry. This research aims to enhance understanding of avian eyesight and how pigeons navigate. The project, conducted by the University of British Columbia, highlights the intersection of technology and animal behavior in scientific exploration.

science.title: Iceland Braces for Total Solar Eclipse Tourism Boom as Hotels Sell Out and Travel Prices Surge Ahead of August 12, 2026: Is This Europe’s Biggest Celestial Travel Event Yet?
science.summary: Iceland is preparing for a significant influx of tourists for the total solar eclipse on August 12, 2026. Hotels are selling out rapidly, and travel prices are increasing as visitors flock to the island for the event. This eclipse is expected to be one of Europe’s most notable celestial attractions, drawing attention from around the globe.

entertainment.title: The Odyssey box office collection day 2: Christopher Nolan film sees strong growth, earns over ₹39 crore
entertainment.summary: The Odyssey, directed by Christopher Nolan, earned over ₹39 crore in its second day at the box office, marking a 26.4% increase from its opening day collection of ₹17.40 crore. This growth indicates strong audience interest and positive word of mouth. The film is Nolan's first feature after Oppenheimer, which won seven Academy Awards.

entertainment.title: Weekly Tarot Forecast for all Sun Signs from July 20 to July 26 : See what this week holds for you
entertainment.summary: The weekly tarot forecast for all sun signs from July 20 to July 26 highlights themes of change, caution, and self-awareness. Each sign receives guidance on work, money, relationships, and health. The forecast emphasizes the importance of adaptability and openness to new experiences, suggesting that abundance and acclaim are possible if individuals embrace these qualities.

entertainment.title: Jyotika reacts to Rajkummar Rao's 'Srikanth' winning National Award: 'It battled situations...'
entertainment.summary: Rajkummar Rao's film 'Srikanth' won the Best Hindi Feature Film award at the 72nd National Film Awards. Jyotika praised the film as an emotional victory, commending both Rao and director Tushar Hiranandani. Additionally, 'Article 370' received the Best Film award, while Yami Gautam Dhar was honored with the Best Actress title for her performance.
